description: This file defines the LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and is used to hold filtering parameters for leave type searches within the OrangeHRM application. It includes properties for specifying the search criteria (e.g., name) and initialization logic for sorting.

classes.name: LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object used for specifying filtering parameters related to leave types, such as the name of the leave type, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'leaveType.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the name filter parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the name filter parameter.
